title: Rolling-chassis vehicle sim: soft tires, solid axles, open diffs, and terrain that deforms
author: clockwork_blue

comments.author: waxenpi
comments.body: Prob the coolest thing I’ve seen on this sub

comments.author: Grahitek
comments.body:
Pretty cool!  
How are you handling physics? Did you fork an existing one and added custom vehicle physics on top, or built everything from scratch?

replies.author: clockwork_blue
replies.body: Godot's Jolt, but most of it is custom solvers on top of it. The terramechanics is completely custom.

replies.author: Lavio00
replies.body: Can you share how you did it?

replies.author: clockwork_blue
replies.body: Lots of small test scenes: one obstacle or one surface at a time, run, measure, adjust, repeat. I've gone through a couple hundred iterations of the contact testbed alone. The video is basically those testbeds filmed. Might do a write-up on the process later.

replies.author: Lavio00
replies.body: Would be amazing. You’re building a highly scalable vehicle physics system on top of jolt. Impressive!

comments.author: caligari1973
comments.body: Nice, when using the app can you design or add other chassis and engine solutions?

replies.author: clockwork_blue
replies.body: Yes, it's universal. But guiding Astra to properly model the entire vehicle is a very thorough process (not special to the solution itself - making realistic vehicles modelled from the ground up is very complicated)

comments.author: ffktiv
comments.body: How much credits/tokens did it use? How did you use Astra? Through opencode?

replies.author: ffktiv
replies.body: Will it be open source or is it part of a game or just a prototype?

replies.author: clockwork_blue
replies.body: Started as a prototype: "what if you could have Spintires/MudRunner, but vehicles didn't move at a snail's pace?" The tire complexity came later. In mud the wheel contact has to do a lot of work and goes through different states, and hitting rocks and other obstacles off-road turned out to be really challenging. Then ideas started coming for how this could become a game, so I'm going to keep grinding on it and see where it goes. No plans to open source it for now.

replies.author: ffktiv
replies.body: I would really love to see an end result. My dream game kind of incorporates this mechanic.

replies.author: clockwork_blue
replies.body: A *lot* 😅. Several accounts. Used it through Codex.
